description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1932/60, Panadura D/S Division and other amendments
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains multiple entries detailing specific modifications to land parcel numbers, ownership records, mortgage information, and servitude rights for various land parcels in different locations. The content is purely land and property-related, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it involves land title registrations, property ownership amendments, and land record modifications without any government personnel changes or structural administrative matters.
